name: aura-airport-retail-media
description: Airport retail media platform — ads on airport screens, timed to the passengers actually in front of them.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm -w @aura/core run build && npm -w @aura/api run db:reset
scripts.db:reset: npm -w @aura/core run build && npm -w @aura/api run db:reset
scripts.dev: npm -w @aura/core run build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm -w @aura/api run dev" "npm -w @aura/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @aura/core run build && npm -w @aura/api run build && npm -w @aura/web run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm -w @aura/api run start
scripts.test: npm -w @aura/core run test && npm -w @aura/api run build && npm -w @aura/api run test
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
